description: Two years after her disbarment, Lidia is campaigning for women's legal and political rights when the murder of journalist Attila Brusaferro exposes a deeper conspiracy. She and Jacopo follow the trail toward Nitti while new prosecutor Pierluigi Fourneau becomes both investigative partner and romantic complication, and Enrico is pushed toward a parliamentary career that could advance Lidia's proposed law. Separate murders keep intersecting with the political plot until the conspiracy and Lidia's personal loyalties collide.

s02e01.description: Lidia is determined to keep fighting for equality. When a friend is murdered and found with two cryptic notes in his pocket, she teams up with Jacopo.

s02e02.description: As Lidia investigates a mysterious poisoning at a prestigious boarding school, Jacopo digs deeper into their friend's death and Marianna uncovers a lie.

s02e03.description: Enrico remains doubtful about running for Parliament while Prosecutor Fourneau and Lidia struggle to connect the victims of a series of brutal murders.

s02e04.description: An unexpected wedding is disrupted by an unexpected death. As Lidia looks to get to the bottom of it, Enrico prepares a very important speech.

s02e05.description: Despite Lidia's conflicted feelings for Fourneau, the murder of a prison guard forces them to collaborate again, as Jacopo edges closer to finding Nitti.

s02e06.description: In the wake of a shooting, Fourneau takes over the Nitti investigation. Enrico receives an eminent guest, while Lidia and Jacopo race against the clock.
